title: KineFlex Category Feed Schema
description: Standard schema for KineFlex CloudStream home category feeds.

id.description: The TMDB ID of the movie or TV show. Must be an integer or integer string.

title.description: Title of the media item (or 'name' for TV series).

name.description: Alternative title field, standard for TMDB TV shows.

year.description: Four-digit release year as an integer or string.

imgs.description: Fully qualified image URL or TMDB poster path (e.g., /oYuLEt3zVCKq57qu2F8dT7NIa6f.jpg).

poster_path.description: Standard TMDB relative path for poster.

type.description: Media classification. Use 'movie' for films and 'tv' or 'series' for television series.
